functions.name: Bytes::decodeUtf8
functions.description: Strict decoding; invalid UTF-8 raises `EncodingError`.

functions.name: Bytes::encodeUtf8
functions.description: Encodes the string as UTF-8 bytes.

functions.name: Bytes::slice
functions.signature: Bytes::slice(data: bytes, start: int, length: int optional): bytes
functions.description: Nonnegative byte positions; omitted length returns the suffix. Start at the end is allowed; invalid bounds raise `RangeError`. A slice can split a UTF-8 sequence.

functions.name: Cli::arg
functions.description: Zero-based nonnegative int index; string or null if out of range.

functions.name: Cli::args
functions.description: All script arguments as UTF-8 strings, preserved verbatim.

functions.name: Cli::has
functions.description: Whether an option is present before the first `--`.

functions.name: Cli::isTerminal
functions.description: Whether the process's `"stdin"`, `"stdout"`, or `"stderr"` handle connects to a terminal.

functions.name: Cli::option
functions.description: Last occurrence's value string, or null for absent/valueless options.

functions.name: Cli::prompt
functions.description: Writes and flushes a string prompt, reads one UTF-8 line, strips LF/CRLF, and returns it; EOF gives null.

functions.name: Cli::readLine
functions.signature: Cli::readLine(maxLineBytes: int optional): string or null
functions.description: Reads a bounded UTF-8 stdin line without writing or flushing output. Default raw line limit is 1 MiB; EOF returns null.

functions.name: Clock::monotonicMs
functions.description: Returns nonnegative monotonic milliseconds. Use differences to measure elapsed time, not calendar dates.

functions.name: Csv::close
functions.description: Idempotently closes the reader and all aliases; `reader->closed` reports state.

functions.name: Csv::encode
functions.description: Writes rows of strings with necessary quoting and CRLF record terminators. Empty rows input returns an empty string.

functions.name: Csv::open
functions.description: Opens a regular file with the same filesystem policy as `File::read`.

functions.name: Csv::parse
functions.description: Returns a list of rows, each a list of strings. Empty input returns an empty list.

functions.name: Csv::readRow
functions.description: Reads a complete record; null at EOF. Reading an explicitly closed reader raises `StreamError`.

functions.name: Date::format
functions.signature: Date::format(timestamp: int, format: string, timezone: string optional): string
functions.description: Formats signed Unix milliseconds using Chrono strftime directives. Omitted timezone means UTC; pass `"local"`, `"UTC"`, or an IANA name such as `"America/New_York"`.

functions.name: Date::now
functions.description: Current wall-clock Unix **milliseconds**; may move backward when the system clock changes. Timezone selection changes display, not this instant.

functions.name: Date::parse
functions.description: Parses RFC 3339 with an explicit `Z` or numeric offset, returning UTC Unix milliseconds. Submillisecond precision is floored, including dates before 1970.

functions.name: Date::sleep
functions.description: Same nonnegative int duration, `sleep` permission, and cooperative cancellation as global `sleep`. Uses monotonic elapsed time.

functions.name: Dir::change
functions.description: Requires an existing directory and saves its canonical absolute path in this runtime.

functions.name: Dir::create
functions.description: Creates one new directory; its parent must exist. Any existing name raises an error.

functions.name: Dir::createAll
functions.description: Creates missing parents; an existing directory succeeds. Files and final symlinks are rejected.

functions.name: Dir::current
functions.description: Canonical absolute runtime working directory.

functions.name: Dir::directories
functions.description: Shallow list of directory snapshots in the same order.

functions.name: Dir::entries
functions.description: Shallow, sorted list of maps with `name`, absolute `path`, `isDirectory`, `isFile`, and `isSymlink`. Includes dangling links and special files without resolving targets. Uses the execution value-byte limit before growing the result.

functions.name: Dir::exists
functions.description: True for a directory; false for missing paths, files, and final symlinks. Other errors propagate.

functions.name: Dir::files
functions.description: Shallow list of regular-file `DirEntry` snapshots, sorted by UTF-8 name in case-sensitive lexical order.

functions.name: Dir::remove
functions.description: Removes only an empty directory. Rejects root, current directory, and its ancestors. There is no recursive-delete argument or API.

functions.name: Env::all
functions.description: UTF-8 string keys/values, deterministically sorted by name.

functions.name: Env::get
functions.description: String value or null if absent; an empty value is an empty string.

functions.name: Env::has
functions.description: Whether the name is present, including empty values.

functions.name: Env::remove
functions.description: Removes a name; an already absent name succeeds.

functions.name: Env::set
functions.description: Both arguments must be strings. Replaces/adds the runtime-local value.

functions.name: File::append
functions.description: Creates a missing file or appends UTF-8 bytes to a regular file.

functions.name: File::appendBytes
functions.description: Creates a missing file or appends exact bytes.

functions.name: File::close
functions.description: Idempotently closes the stream and all its aliases.

functions.name: File::copy
functions.description: Copies bytes, including binary files, to a new file. Refuses any existing destination, including symlinks and directories. Does not copy metadata/permissions.

functions.name: File::delete
functions.description: Deletes one regular file. Missing paths raise an exception. Never deletes directories or symlinks.

functions.name: File::exists
functions.description: True for a regular file. Missing paths, directories, and final symlinks return false. Permission and other inspection failures raise exceptions.

functions.name: File::extension
functions.description: Lexical suffix without the dot, or empty string. Does not require the file to exist; same as `Path::extension`.

functions.name: File::modified
functions.description: Modification time in whole Unix seconds (floored), checked against i64 range.

functions.name: File::move
functions.description: Moves a regular file to a new name, refusing any existing destination. Uses exclusive hard-link creation followed by source removal; cross-device/unsupported-link errors fall back to exclusive copy then removal.

functions.name: File::openLines
functions.signature: File::openLines(path: string, maxLineBytes: int optional): FileStream
functions.description: Opens a UTF-8 line stream; default raw line limit is 1 MiB. See bounded file streams.

functions.name: File::read
functions.description: Reads a complete regular file as UTF-8. Invalid file bytes raise `EncodingError`.

functions.name: File::readBytes
functions.description: Reads a complete regular file without text decoding, subject to the execution value limit.

functions.name: File::readLine
functions.description: Returns the next line without LF/CRLF, or null at EOF.

functions.name: File::size
functions.description: Regular-file size in bytes, checked against i64 range.

functions.name: File::write
functions.description: Creates or truncates a regular file, replacing its contents. Parent directories must exist.

functions.name: File::writeAtomic
functions.description: Stages a complete UTF-8 file beside the destination, then atomically creates or replaces it. Parent directory must exist; final symlinks, nonregular files, and read-only destinations are rejected.

functions.name: File::writeBytes
functions.description: Creates or truncates a regular file and writes the exact bytes.

functions.name: Form::decode
functions.description: Parses a form body into ordered two-string pairs. Converts raw `+` to space before percent-decoding; does not remove a leading `?`.

functions.name: Form::encode
functions.description: Builds an `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` body. Spaces become `+`; ASCII letters, digits, and `*-._` remain unchanged.

functions.name: Html::escape
functions.description: Escapes plain UTF-8 text for HTML text nodes and ordinary quoted attribute values.

functions.name: Http::download
functions.signature: Http::download(url: string, destination: string, options optional): map
functions.description: Streams an HTTP/HTTPS response to a new destination using staged publication. Refuses overwrite.

functions.name: Http::get
functions.description: Makes a synchronous HTTP/HTTPS GET request and returns a bounded response.

functions.name: Http::post
functions.signature: Http::post(url: string, body: string or bytes, options = []): HttpResponse
functions.description: Makes a synchronous HTTP/HTTPS POST request with a string or byte body.

functions.name: Http::request
functions.signature: Http::request(method: string, url: string, options = []): HttpResponse
functions.description: Makes a synchronous HTTP/HTTPS request. Supply a request body through options.

functions.name: Json::decode
functions.description: Decodes JSON into Scripta values. Invalid JSON raises JsonError.

functions.name: Json::encode
functions.description: Encodes a value as compact JSON. Map keys must be strings; native objects and callables are rejected.

functions.name: Json::pretty
functions.description: Encodes JSON with two-space indentation.

functions.name: List::chunk
functions.description: Returns contiguous sublists of at most size elements, with a possibly shorter final sublist. Size must be positive, otherwise `RangeError`. Empty input returns `[]`.

functions.name: List::column
functions.signature: List::column(rows: list, field: int or string): list
functions.description: Extracts field from each map row in order. Non-map rows raise `TypeError`, missing fields raise `RangeError`, and stored null is retained. Empty rows return `[]`.

functions.name: List::concat
functions.description: Returns left's elements followed by right's. Empty lists are valid. Both inputs remain unchanged.

functions.name: List::contains
functions.description: Tests membership with strict recursive equality, like `===`. Int `1`, float `1.0`, and string `"1"` differ. Lists compare in order; maps compare contents independent of insertion order. Native objects and callables compare by identity. Empty lists return false.

functions.name: List::diff
functions.description: Keeps left values absent from right, using strict recursive equality. Preserves left order and duplicates.

functions.name: List::fill
functions.description: Generates count independent copies of value. Count must be nonnegative, otherwise `RangeError`; zero returns `[]`.

functions.name: List::intersect
functions.description: Keeps left values present in right, using strict recursive equality. Preserves left order and duplicates; right duplicates do not multiply results.

functions.name: List::pop
functions.description: Removes the last value and returns `["items" => remainingList, "value" => removedValue]`. Empty input raises `RangeError`; a removed null remains null.

functions.name: List::product
functions.description: Multiplies with the same numeric rules as `sum`. Empty input returns integer `1`.

functions.name: List::push
functions.description: Appends one value to a copy. Use `concat` to append another list's elements.

functions.name: List::remove
functions.description: Copies the list without the existing zero-based index and renumbers remaining positions. Negative or absent positions raise `RangeError`, including removal from an empty list.

functions.name: List::reverse
functions.description: Reverses element order. Empty input returns `[]`.

functions.name: List::search
functions.signature: List::search(items: list, value: any): int or null
functions.description: Returns the first strictly equal value's index, or null when absent. Index zero is a successful match.

functions.name: List::shift
functions.description: Like `pop`, but removes the first value.

functions.name: List::slice
functions.signature: List::slice(items: list, start: int, length: int optional): list
functions.description: Copies a contiguous range using nonnegative positions. Omitted length copies the suffix. Start beyond `len(items)`, negative offsets, or length beyond the remainder raise `RangeError`. Start at the end with omitted or zero length returns `[]`; `List::slice([], 0)` returns `[]`. Explicit null is not an omitted length.

functions.name: List::sort
functions.signature: List::sort(items: list, descending: bool optional): list
functions.description: Returns a stable sorted copy, ascending by default. Nonempty lists must contain only ints, only finite floats, or only strings. Mixed types, bools, nulls, collections, objects, and callables raise `TypeError`, even in a single-element list. Empty lists are valid. Set descending to true to reverse the comparison direction while preserving equal elements' original order.

functions.name: List::splice
functions.signature: List::splice(items: list, start: int, length: int, replacement: list optional): map
functions.description: Returns `["items" => updatedList, "removed" => removedList]`. Replacement defaults to `[]`. Start and length must be nonnegative, start cannot exceed the list length, and length cannot exceed the remainder; violations raise `RangeError`. Zero length inserts without removing. Start at the end permits appending. Explicit null is not an omitted replacement.

functions.name: List::sum
functions.description: Adds homogeneous ints or finite floats in input order. Empty input returns integer `0`. Mixed types and nonnumeric/nonfinite inputs raise `TypeError`; integer overflow and nonfinite intermediate float results raise `ArithmeticError`.

functions.name: List::unique
functions.description: Keeps the first occurrence of each value using strict recursive equality. Preserves order.

functions.name: List::unshift
functions.description: Prepends one value to a copy.

functions.name: Log::debug
functions.description: Writes a debug message as a JSON line to the configured log destination.

functions.name: Log::error
functions.description: Writes an error message as a JSON line to the configured log destination.

functions.name: Log::info
functions.description: Writes an info message as a JSON line to the configured log destination.

functions.name: Log::setFile
functions.description: Selects an append-only log file. Pass null to restore stderr.

functions.name: Log::warn
functions.description: Writes a warning message as a JSON line to the configured log destination.

functions.name: Map::column
functions.signature: Map::column(rows: list, field: int or string, indexField: int or string): map
functions.description: Extracts field values keyed by each row's indexField value. Rows must be maps and both fields must exist, with the same errors as List column. Index values must be ints or strings. Duplicate indexes overwrite values without moving their first insertion position. Empty rows return an empty map.

functions.name: Map::combine
functions.description: Builds a map from equally sized lists, otherwise `RangeError`. Keys must be ints or strings, otherwise `TypeError`. Later duplicate keys overwrite values while retaining their first insertion position. Empty lists produce an empty map.

functions.name: Map::create
functions.description: Returns an empty map. `[]` continues to create an empty list. Add map entries with normal indexed assignment.

functions.name: Map::diff
functions.description: Keeps left entries whose values are absent from right, using strict recursive equality. Preserves left keys and order.

functions.name: Map::diffKeys
functions.description: Keeps left entries whose exact typed keys are absent from right. Preserves left order.

functions.name: Map::flip
functions.description: Exchanges values and keys. Input values must be ints or strings, otherwise `TypeError`. Duplicate generated keys use the same overwrite and insertion rule as combine.

functions.name: Map::get
functions.signature: Map::get(items: map, key: int or string, default: any optional): any
functions.description: Returns a copy of an existing value, or the default if the key is absent. Omitted default is null. A stored null is returned as null, not replaced by the default. As in other calls, default arguments are evaluated eagerly even when the key exists.

functions.name: Map::has
functions.signature: Map::has(items: map, key: int or string): bool
functions.description: Tests whether the exact typed key exists, including keys whose value is null.

functions.name: Map::intersect
functions.description: Keeps left entries whose values occur in right, using strict recursive equality. Preserves left keys and order.

functions.name: Map::intersectKeys
functions.description: Keeps left entries whose exact typed keys occur in right. Preserves left order.

functions.name: Map::keys
functions.description: Returns the map's keys in insertion order, preserving each int/string type. An empty map returns `[]`.

functions.name: Map::merge
functions.description: Right values replace matching typed keys without moving their positions. New keys append in right order. Numeric keys are preserved.

functions.name: Map::remove
functions.signature: Map::remove(items: map, key: int or string): map
functions.description: Returns a copy without that key, preserving the remaining entries' order. An absent key returns an unchanged copy, including for an empty map.

functions.name: Map::replace
functions.description: Like merge, but ignores right keys absent from left.

functions.name: Map::reverse
functions.description: Reverses entry order while preserving typed keys.

functions.name: Map::search
functions.signature: Map::search(items: map, value: any): int or string or null
functions.description: Returns the first strictly equal value's typed key in insertion order, or null when absent.

functions.name: Map::values
functions.description: Returns copies of values in insertion order. An empty map returns `[]`.

functions.name: Math::abs
functions.signature: Math::abs(value: int or float): int or float
functions.description: Absolute value. i64 minimum raises `ArithmeticError` because its positive value cannot fit in i64. Float negative zero becomes positive zero.

functions.name: Math::ceil
functions.signature: Math::ceil(value: int or float): int or float
functions.description: Rounds toward positive infinity; ints are unchanged. `Math::ceil(-1.2)` returns float -1.0.

functions.name: Math::floor
functions.signature: Math::floor(value: int or float): int or float
functions.description: Rounds toward negative infinity; ints are unchanged. `Math::floor(-1.2)` returns float -2.0.

functions.name: Math::max
functions.description: Larger of two ints or two finite floats. Equal values select the left argument, including signed zero.

functions.name: Math::min
functions.description: Smaller of two ints or two finite floats. Equal values select the left argument, including signed zero.

functions.name: Math::round
functions.signature: Math::round(value: int or float): int or float
functions.description: Nearest integer, with halfway ties away from zero: 2.5 becomes 3.0 and -2.5 becomes -3.0. Ints are unchanged.

functions.name: Password::hash
functions.description: Hash using Argon2id v19, a fresh 16-byte OS-random salt, and a 32-byte digest. Returns the complete PHC-format string.

functions.name: Password::needsRehash
functions.description: True for malformed/unsupported hashes, or supported hashes whose costs, salt length, or digest length differ from the current generation policy. No password hashing is performed.

functions.name: Password::verify
functions.description: Verify an Argon2id v19 hash using its bounded encoded parameters. Wrong passwords and malformed/unsupported hashes return false.

functions.name: Path::absolute
functions.description: Resolves against the runtime directory, then lexically normalizes. The target need not exist.

functions.name: Path::canonical
functions.description: Resolve an existing filesystem path, following links under read/root policies.

functions.name: Path::extension
functions.description: Last extension without dot. `.hidden` has no extension; `a.tar.gz` gives `gz`.

functions.name: Path::filename
functions.description: Final filename component, or empty string if none.

functions.name: Path::join
functions.description: Joins zero or more native path components. An absolute later component replaces the previous path, following Rust path rules. Zero arguments returns empty string.

functions.name: Path::normalize
functions.description: Lexically removes `.` and collapses `..`, preserving leading relative `..` and stopping at absolute roots. Empty input normalizes to `.`.

functions.name: Path::parent
functions.description: Lexical parent, or empty string if none (including a bare filename or root).

functions.name: Process::currentId
functions.description: Current Scripta host process ID.

functions.name: Process::exists
functions.description: Requires a positive representable PID and reports whether it appears in a fresh process-inspection snapshot. OS visibility restrictions can make another user's process invisible.

functions.name: Process::kill
functions.description: Requests forced termination, waits for cleanup, and returns the resulting status. A completed handle retains its original result.

functions.name: Process::poll
functions.description: Returns null while pending; otherwise returns the result or raises the stored error.

functions.name: Process::run
functions.signature: Process::run(command: string, arguments: list = [], options = []): ProcessResult
functions.description: Runs an executable with literal arguments and waits for its result. Does not invoke a shell.

functions.name: Process::shell
functions.description: Executes shell code. Requires the process.shell capability.

functions.name: Process::spawn
functions.signature: Process::spawn(command: string, arguments: list = [], options = []): ProcessHandle
functions.description: Starts an executable with literal arguments and returns a process handle immediately.

functions.name: Process::wait
functions.description: Waits and returns a ProcessResult, or raises the stored launch-monitor error. Repeated waits retain the completed result.

functions.name: Regex::findAll
functions.description: Full matched strings in left-to-right, nonoverlapping order; empty list for no match.

functions.name: Regex::isMatch
functions.description: Whether the pattern matches anywhere in the text. Use anchors for a full-text match.

functions.name: Regex::replace
functions.description: Replaces all nonoverlapping matches with the literal replacement. `$1`, backslashes, and capture names have no special replacement meaning.

functions.name: Session::all
functions.description: Snapshot of all session fields in insertion order. Available only in a web request context.

functions.name: Session::close
functions.description: Commit immediately and release the record lock. Further session access fails. Later request errors do not undo this explicit early commit. Available only in a web request context.

functions.name: Session::destroy
functions.description: Stage deletion of server data and expiration of the session cookie. Further session access in this request fails. Available only in a web request context.

functions.name: Session::get
functions.signature: Session::get(key: string, default: any = null): any
functions.description: Stored value, including stored null; default only when the key is absent. Available only in a web request context.

functions.name: Session::has
functions.description: Distinguishes an absent key from a stored null. Available only in a web request context.

functions.name: Session::id
functions.description: Current opaque 64-character lowercase hexadecimal ID. Available only in a web request context.

functions.name: Session::regenerate
functions.description: Generate a fresh ID, preserving data; revoke the previous ID on commit. At most once per request. Call after successful authentication. Available only in a web request context.

functions.name: Session::remove
functions.description: Remove a key; return whether it existed. Available only in a web request context.

functions.name: Session::set
functions.description: Set/replace a value without moving an existing key's insertion position. Available only in a web request context.

functions.name: Session::start
functions.description: Resume a known, unexpired session or generate a new random one. Idempotent while open. Available only in a web request context.

functions.name: Socket::accept
functions.description: Accepts at most one connection. Reserves a handle slot before removing a connection from the queue. Accepted sockets inherit logical blocking mode, timeout, and transfer ceiling.

functions.name: Socket::bindDatagram
functions.signature: Socket::bindDatagram(address: string, port: int, options = []): DatagramSocket
functions.description: Binds unconnected UDP; port 0 is allowed.

functions.name: Socket::close
functions.description: Shared, idempotent close for TCP/UDP/listeners; no I/O capability needed for cleanup.

functions.name: Socket::connect
functions.signature: Socket::connect(address: string, port: int, options = []): ByteStream
functions.description: Connects TCP to a literal IP and port 1–65535. Handshake is a bounded blocking backend call, then I/O honors the logical blocking mode.

functions.name: Socket::getOption
functions.signature: Socket::getOption(socket, name: string): bool or int
functions.description: Returns the OS-reported option, which may differ from the requested buffer size.

functions.name: Socket::listen
functions.signature: Socket::listen(address: string, port: int, options = []): SocketListener
functions.description: Binds and listens in one operation; port 0 chooses an ephemeral port.

functions.name: Socket::localAddress
functions.description: `address` and `port` of the bound endpoint.

functions.name: Socket::peerAddress
functions.description: Connected TCP/UDP peer; errors for listeners and unconnected UDP.

functions.name: Socket::poll
functions.signature: Socket::poll(read: list, write: list, milliseconds: int): map
functions.description: Returns `readable`/`writable` lists of ready handles; unique results preserve each input list's order. Zero timeout probes immediately; EOF/error readiness is included. Requires at least one socket.

functions.name: Socket::read
functions.signature: Socket::read(socket: ByteStream, length: int): bytes or null
functions.description: TCP read with the same binary/short-read/EOF rules as `Stream::read`.

functions.name: Socket::receive
functions.description: One UDP packet, preserving empty packets and reporting sender/truncation; same result as `Stream::receive`.

functions.name: Socket::sendTo
functions.signature: Socket::sendTo(socket: DatagramSocket, data: bytes, address: string, port: int): int
functions.description: One packet to a literal peer from an unconnected bound UDP socket. Connected UDP uses `Stream::send`.

functions.name: Socket::setBlocking
functions.description: Sets logical blocking behavior, shared by aliases.

functions.name: Socket::setOption
functions.description: Supported runtime options below; strict types.

functions.name: Socket::setTimeout
functions.description: Sets a positive operation timeout within the host ceiling.

functions.name: Socket::shutdown
functions.description: TCP half/full shutdown: `read`, `write`, or `both`. Does not close the handle or release its slot.

functions.name: Socket::write
functions.description: TCP write returning actual bytes written; finish short writes explicitly.

functions.name: Sqlite::close
functions.description: Closes the connection and releases locks. Repeated closes succeed. Subsequent execute/query calls fail. Requires a build with SQLite enabled (included by default).

functions.name: Sqlite::execute
functions.signature: Sqlite::execute(db: SqliteDatabase, sql: string, params: list optional): int
functions.description: Executes one statement that returns no columns. Returns the directly affected row count for DML, excluding trigger changes; DDL and transaction statements return zero. Parameters default to `[]`. Requires a build with SQLite enabled (included by default).

functions.name: Sqlite::open
functions.signature: Sqlite::open(path: string, readOnly: bool optional, busyTimeoutMs: int optional): SqliteDatabase
functions.description: Opens a file database, creating it if needed in writable mode, or opens a private `:memory:` database. Defaults: `readOnly = false`, `busyTimeoutMs = 1000`. The busy timeout must be between 0 and 5000 ms. Requires a build with SQLite enabled (included by default).

functions.name: Sqlite::query
functions.signature: Sqlite::query(db: SqliteDatabase, sql: string, params: list optional): list
functions.description: Executes one read-only statement returning columns. Returns a list of maps keyed by column name, including `[]` for no rows. Parameters default to `[]`. Requires a build with SQLite enabled (included by default).

functions.name: Stream::close
functions.description: Closes shared handle state. Idempotent for an owned handle; aliases also become closed. Requires ownership, but no I/O capability for cleanup.

functions.name: Stream::copy
functions.signature: Stream::copy(source: ByteStream, destination: ByteStream, maxBytes: int): int
functions.description: Copies up to a bounded count using at most 64 KiB chunks, completing short writes. Rejects the same handle. Validates count against both handles' remaining transfer budgets before I/O.

functions.name: Stream::eof
functions.description: True after a positive read observes EOF. A short nonempty read does not establish EOF.

functions.name: Stream::flush
functions.description: Flushes a writable file/TCP handle; UDP is a no-op. Read-only HTTP/input handles reject it. Does not flush script output buffers or guarantee durable disk storage.

functions.name: Stream::open
functions.signature: Stream::open(uri: string, mode: string optional, options = []): ByteStream or DatagramSocket
functions.description: Opens a file, HTTP response body, or connected transport. Default mode is `r` for files/HTTP, `rw` for TCP/UDP.

functions.name: Stream::read
functions.signature: Stream::read(stream: ByteStream, length: int): bytes or null
functions.description: Reads up to the requested count; short reads are valid. Positive reads return null only at EOF. Zero length returns empty bytes without consuming input or changing EOF.

functions.name: Stream::receive
functions.description: Receives exactly one packet and returns `data: bytes`, `address: string` (source IP), `port: int`, and `truncated: bool`. Keeps at most length bytes and discards the remainder of that packet. Empty packets remain ordinary results.

functions.name: Stream::request
functions.signature: Stream::request(method: string, url: string, source: ByteStream, options = []): ByteStream
functions.description: Sends an incrementally consumed **readable file or request-input stream** as an HTTP request body, returning a readable HTTP response stream. Source is not closed on success.

functions.name: Stream::seek
functions.signature: Stream::seek(stream: ByteStream, offset: int, origin: string = "start"): int
functions.description: File-only seek; `start` uses nonnegative offsets, `current`/`end` accept signed offsets. Returns the new position and clears EOF.

functions.name: Stream::send
functions.description: Sends exactly one UDP datagram, including a zero-length packet.

functions.name: Stream::tell
functions.description: File-only current position; does not change EOF.

functions.name: Stream::write
functions.description: Writes up to one bounded chunk; returns the actual count, possibly short. Call again for unwritten bytes. Strings require `Bytes::encodeUtf8`.

functions.name: String::contains
functions.description: True when the literal search occurs anywhere in text. An empty search returns true, including in empty text.

functions.name: String::endsWith
functions.description: True when text ends with the literal search. An empty search returns true.

functions.name: String::format
functions.description: Replaces sequential `{}` placeholders with scalar display. `{{` and `}}` emit literal braces. See the formatting contract below.

functions.name: String::graphemeLength
functions.description: Counts extended Unicode grapheme clusters.

functions.name: String::graphemeSubstring
functions.signature: String::graphemeSubstring(text: string, start: int, length: int optional): string
functions.description: Extracts text using nonnegative grapheme cluster positions. Omitted length returns the suffix.

functions.name: String::join
functions.description: Joins a list containing only strings. Empty input returns `""`, one item returns that item, and an empty separator concatenates items. Non-string elements raise `TypeError`.

functions.name: String::lower
functions.description: Applies locale-independent Unicode lowercase, including contextual Greek final sigma. Empty input returns `""`. Mappings can expand a scalar, such as `İ` becoming `i` plus a combining dot.

functions.name: String::replace
functions.signature: String::replace(text: string, search: string, replacement: string): string
functions.description: Replaces all literal, nonoverlapping matches from left to right. Replacement text is not searched again. No match returns the original text's value; an empty replacement deletes matches. An empty search raises `RangeError`.

functions.name: String::split
functions.description: Splits on literal, nonoverlapping separators and preserves leading, trailing, and consecutive empty fields. Empty text returns `[""]`; no match returns `[text]`. An empty separator raises `RangeError`.

functions.name: String::startsWith
functions.description: True when text begins with the literal search. An empty search returns true.

functions.name: String::substring
functions.signature: String::substring(text: string, start: int, length: int optional): string
functions.description: Takes nonnegative Unicode scalar positions. Omitted length returns the suffix. Start beyond `len(text)`, negative offsets, or length beyond the remaining text raise `RangeError`. Start at the end is valid with omitted length or length zero. Empty text accepts start zero with omitted length or length zero. Explicit null is not an omitted length.

functions.name: String::trim
functions.description: Removes Unicode whitespace from both ends, preserving interior whitespace. Empty or all-whitespace input returns `""`.

functions.name: String::upper
functions.description: Applies locale-independent Unicode uppercase. Empty input returns `""`. Mappings can expand scalars, such as `ß` becoming `SS`.

functions.name: System::architecture
functions.description: Returns the compiled target architecture, such as aarch64 or x86_64.

functions.name: System::cpuUsage
functions.description: Blocking system-wide average CPU utilization from two counter observations, normalized across logical CPUs to 0–100 percent.

functions.name: System::diskUsage
functions.description: Capacity of the filesystem containing an existing file/directory. Relative paths use runtime cwd. Requires `filesystem.read` and respects the host root policy.

functions.name: System::homeDirectory
functions.description: Native current user's home directory, using Rust's OS/environment lookup.

functions.name: System::hostname
functions.description: Native hostname; unavailable/empty results raise `UnsupportedError`.

functions.name: System::memoryUsage
functions.description: Physical **system RAM**, not this process's resident/virtual memory, swap, or container memory limit.

functions.name: System::platform
functions.description: Returns the target OS identifier, such as linux, macos, or windows.

functions.name: System::tempDirectory
functions.description: Rust's native temporary directory selection. Does not create or guarantee writability of the directory.

functions.name: System::uptime
functions.description: Whole seconds since OS boot, not runtime/process age. Zero/unavailable results raise `UnsupportedError`.

functions.name: Url::buildQuery
functions.description: Encodes names/values and joins them with `&` and `=`, without a leading `?`.

functions.name: Url::decodeComponent
functions.description: Decodes percent escapes once; literal `+` remains `+`.

functions.name: Url::encodeComponent
functions.description: Percent-encodes UTF-8 bytes, leaving only ASCII letters, digits, and `-._~` unchanged. Spaces become `%20`; literal `+` becomes `%2B`.

functions.name: Url::parseQuery
functions.description: Parses a query into ordered two-string pairs, optionally removing one leading `?`. Literal `+` remains `+`.

functions.name: Web::addHeader
functions.description: Appends a header, preserving repeated values such as `Set-Cookie`. Available only in a web request context.

functions.name: Web::cookie
functions.signature: Web::cookie(name: string, value: string, options = []): null
functions.description: Appends a validated Set-Cookie header; UTF-8 values are percent-encoded. Available only in a web request context.

functions.name: Web::deleteCookie
functions.description: Appends a deletion cookie for the chosen path/domain. Available only in a web request context.

functions.name: Web::download
functions.description: Streams a readable file from its current position as an attachment. Returns bytes written (zero for HEAD). Requires no prior body output or active application buffers. See file transfers. Available only in a web request context.

functions.name: Web::header
functions.description: Replaces all headers with this case-insensitive name. Does not change status automatically. Available only in a web request context.

functions.name: Web::redirect
functions.description: Replaces `Location` and sets 301, 302, 303, 307, or 308. Does not stop execution; follow with `exit 0`. Available only in a web request context.

functions.name: Web::request
functions.description: Returns this request's read-only object. Available only in a web request context.

functions.name: Web::status
functions.description: Sets status 200–599; defaults to 200. Informational responses are not supported. Available only in a web request context.

functions.name: Web::write
functions.description: Appends UTF-8 or arbitrary bytes to the bounded response body. `echo` also writes the body, with its usual strict types. Available only in a web request context.

functions.name: bool
functions.description: Bool is unchanged; numeric 0/1 become false/true; exactly `"false"`/`"true"` become false/true. Other values are errors.

functions.name: float
functions.description: Finite floats are unchanged; ints convert to f64 (large values may round); bool becomes 0.0/1.0; strings must parse as finite floating-point numbers without whitespace.

functions.name: flush
functions.description: Request a flush of the underlying host writer. Does not drain application buffers.

functions.name: int
functions.description: Int is unchanged; bool becomes 0/1; a finite integral float within i64 range is converted exactly; strings must parse as signed decimal i64 without whitespace or fractional/exponent notation.

functions.name: len
functions.description: Counts Unicode scalar values in a string (not bytes or grapheme clusters), bytes in a byte value, or entries in a list/map. Other values are errors.

functions.name: ob_clean
functions.description: Discard the top buffer's bytes, keeping it active.

functions.name: ob_end_clean
functions.description: Discard and remove the top buffer.

functions.name: ob_end_flush
functions.description: Drain and remove the top buffer.

functions.name: ob_flush
functions.description: Drain the top buffer into its parent (or host writer), leaving it active and empty.

functions.name: ob_get_clean
functions.description: Copy then discard/remove the top buffer.

functions.name: ob_get_contents
functions.description: Copy the top buffer; null when no buffer exists.

functions.name: ob_get_flush
functions.description: Copy then drain/remove the top buffer.

functions.name: ob_get_length
functions.description: Top buffer's byte length, or null without a buffer.

functions.name: ob_get_level
functions.description: Number of active application buffers.

functions.name: ob_start
functions.description: Push an empty application buffer.

functions.name: sleep
functions.description: Requires a nonnegative int duration in milliseconds and the `sleep` capability, allowed by default. Zero returns immediately; long sleeps check cancellation in chunks of at most 10 ms of requested sleep. OS scheduling can delay observation.

functions.name: str
functions.description: Null becomes `"null"`; bool becomes `"true"`/`"false"`; int and finite float use decimal display; strings are unchanged.

functions.name: type
functions.description: Returns `null`, `bool`, `int`, `float`, `string`, `bytes`, `list`, `map`, or `callable`. Native objects return their host-defined type name.
